desc: Garden zones (briefs/design/GARDEN.md section 10, scripts/home/garden_zones.gd). zones: id -> name and the Boki types (lean.json keys) that live there, in the order the Waystone lists them. Bramblebank is always open; the rest open when Save.d['zones'] has their id. A Boki's zone is rec['zone'] (missing means Bramblebank). Times are seconds, distances metres.
ask_lean_doc: Evo.lean strength (0..1) a Boki needs in one of another open zone's types before it asks to go there (12 of 24, the unlock bar).
ask_chance_doc: chance a roaming Boki that would thrive elsewhere walks to the return pad and asks, per think; at most once per visit to the zone.
ask_secs_doc: s a Boki waits at the return pad with its bubble before it gives up.
walk_secs_doc: s a Boki gets to reach the return pad (to ask, or sent by 'Move to...') before it gives up asking or blinks out where it stands.
pad_r_doc: m from the pad's centre that counts as standing on it.
waystone_r_doc: m from the Waystone's centre where a Boki you set down opens the zone cards.
